articles.body: Sangeeth Prathap and Sharafudheen's 'It's a Medical Miracle' recorded a drop in its box office collection on Saturday. The Malayalam movie earned Rs 43 lakhs in India on Day 2. According to Sacnilk, the film registered the collection from 654 shows. The latest numbers have taken the movie's total India net collection to Rs 98 lakhs. Its India gross collection currently stands at Rs 1.15 cr. The film had opened with Rs 55 lakhs net on September 18.The second-day collection marks a 21.8% decline from the opening day's earnings. The movie also saw its overall occupancy fall from 22.0% on Friday to 18.0% on Saturday.'It's a Medical Miracle' earns Rs 43 lakhs on Day 2'It's a Medical Miracle' added Rs 43 lakhs to its India net collection on Saturday. The movie recorded 654 shows across the country on its second day. The film had registered Rs 0.55 cr net from 695 shows on Friday. Its opening-day occupancy stood at 22.0%.With the second-day earnings added to its opening collection, 'It's a Medical Miracle' has reached Rs 98 lakhs in India net collections. The movie's India gross total has climbed to Rs 1.15 cr.Saturday occupancy stands at 18%The Malayalam 2D version of 'It's a Medical Miracle' recorded 19.43% overall occupancy based on its show timings on Saturday. The morning shows registered 9.58% occupancy. The afternoon shows recorded 17.08%. The evening shows had 15.83% occupancy, while the night shows registered the highest figure at 30.42%.The overall occupancy was 22.0% on the opening day. The second day therefore brought a decline in both occupancy and net earnings.'It's a Medical Miracle' follows a mysterious journeyThe movie follows a young man who is declared brain-dead but unexpectedly regains consciousness. Despite his condition, he can hear everything happening around him. He then begins searching for the nurse whose voice helped keep him alive. His journey soon takes him into a disturbing world filled with masks, memories and revenge. Every sound becomes potentially important in his search. What appears to be a clue could also turn out to be a trap. Sangeeth Prathap and Sharafudheen play key roles in the movie.ETimes rates 'It's a Medical Miracle' 2.5 starsETimes gave 'It's a Medical Miracle' 2.5 stars out of 5. The review praised Sangeeth Prathap's effort while pointing to limitations in the writing of his character, Ruben."Sangeeth works hard to bring out the layers in Ruben, and there are glimpses of a more complicated character in his performance. But the writing doesn't give those complexities enough room to develop, leaving Ruben ultimately shallow on the page. The problem, then, lies less with what Sangeeth does with the character and more with how Ruben was conceived and written.Sharafudheen is fine as Suraj, but there isn't much for him to work with. Apart from his ‘quirk’ and motivation, Suraj isn't an especially memorable character. The basic idea has a lot of merit, but the execution — and the way his character is left hanging, with little to prop him up, much like Ruben — doesn't help. The actors have made the most of what they have been given."DISCLAIMER: The box office numbers and the data in this article are compiled from public and industry sources. articles.body: Ed Sheeran's latest comments on the Macklemore controversy have triggered mixed reactions among social media users. The singer addressed the issue during his Philadelphia concert on Saturday.The show marked Ed Sheeran's first performance since Macklemore was removed from the Loop Tour. The decision followed Macklemore's pro-Palestinian remarks during a performance earlier this month. Several supporting acts later withdrew from the tour in solidarity with the rapper.During his Philadelphia performance, Ed Sheeran acknowledged that he had made mistakes. He also spoke about the situation in Gaza and his views on free speech.His comments have now divided online opinion. Some fans defended Ed Sheeran's approach to the controversy, while others questioned his response.Netizens react to Ed Sheeran's Philadelphia speechEd Sheeran's remarks generated many reactions on social media. One wrote on X, "The Ed Sheeran concert was packed!! Cancel Culture didn't work!!."Another user questioned the way Ed Sheeran delivered his statement. They wrote, "It would be respectable if he wasn’t reading a script from a teleprompter and was actually talking from his heart..." Another reaction read, "So he lost a lot of support basically for nothing."A separate user focused on Ed Sheeran's comments about the conflict. They wrote, "Him saying \"conflict\" and \"both sides\" is all u need to know on where he stands."Fans defend and criticise Ed SheeranThe singer's statement also drew support from some fans who believed he should have kept politics outside his concerts. One user wrote, "He didn’t do anything wrong….he wanted politics out of his show. He wanted it to just be about music which is what people bought and came for. He shouldn’t have even address the Israel Gaza conflict at all in this speech.."Another user expressed frustration with celebrities discussing international conflicts, writing, "I’m so tired of rich celebrities making some drama over third world countries."Ed Sheeran admits ‘I am making mistakes’Ed Sheeran began his Philadelphia concert at Lincoln Financial Field by discussing the events surrounding his tour. He said the situation had placed him inside a wider debate over free speech."I never wanted to be an activist musician, but this has put me in the middle of an important and passionate argument about free speech and the most complex political issue on the planet," he said at Saturday's show, as quoted by BBC. The singer also apologized while discussing the difficult decisions he had faced."I’ve had to take and make difficult decisions, and I am making mistakes, and I am so, so sorry," Ed Sheeran said.Ed Sheeran had previously said that Macklemore's removal was a decision made by the tour's promoters. Macklemore was removed after his public comments supporting Palestinians. The development was followed by withdrawals from other performers.of course he had to read it off a teleprompter, he gave a whole ass fireside chat right before jumping into a song about kissing a boy or whatever he rattles off about these days— Mike (@MindofMikex) September 20, 2026 Ed Sheeran addresses Israel and PalestineEd Sheeran also explained why he had chosen to speak about the Israel-Palestine situation. He said he had generally tried to avoid presenting himself as a political commentator. "My concerts have always been a safe space for everyone," he said."Now, I want to address the question of where I stand in the situation in Israel and Palestine, and whether my doing this concert here tonight implies where I stand," he said."I have tried in my career not to be a political commentator of any kind, because I want my music and shows to be about unity, not division; about humanity, not politics. But this is a humanitarian issue, and I cannot hide how I feel about it anymore."Ed Sheeran described the October 7, 2023 attacks as "horrific and compounded centuries of Jewish pain". He added: "What is happening in Gaza is catastrophic and unjustifiable and disproportionate. My heart has been broken by the scale of devastation and loss of civilian lives, of children's lives, and this systemic injustice we're seeing unfold in the West Bank cannot be overlooked."He also said he was trying to learn more and find ways to help people affected by the conflict. He said he is trying "to work out how to make a contribution that helps victims of these terrible times and listening and learning, because I do not know enough".Ed Sheeran became emotional while speaking to the audience. He thanked fans for attending the concert and emphasized that people with different opinions could share the same space. "I am honestly so grateful that you're here tonight with me. This concert is still a place where everyone is welcome and everyone here can stand beside people that have opposing views."The Philadelphia concert took place as pro-Palestinian protesters gathered outside Lincoln Financial Field. The demonstration focused on Macklemore's removal and concerns about censorship.Aaron Rowe supports Ed SheeranMeanwhile, Aaron Rowe has spoken in support of Ed Sheeran during the continuing controversy. The Irish singer-songwriter was among the performers who withdrew from the Loop Tour after Macklemore's removal.Aaron Rowe previously said the attention had been directed toward the wrong person. He argued that billionaire businessman Robert Kraft should receive greater scrutiny in the debate.At the same time, Aaron Rowe acknowledged in his Instagram video that Ed Sheeran's response could have been stronger. articles.title: Amitabh Bachchan’s ‘Black’ co-star Ayesha Kapur reveals how film’s success affected her career decisions after 17 years: 'It’s still in people’s hearts'
articles.summary: Ayesha Kapur became a familiar face to audiences at just 10 when she played young Michelle in Sanjay Leela Bhansali’s ‘Black’. Her performance earned .
articles.body: Ayesha Kapur became a familiar face to audiences at just 10 when she played young Michelle in Sanjay Leela Bhansali’s ‘Black’. Her performance earned widespread appreciation and an award, but the attention that followed the film also had an impact on how she approached her career.After appearing in ‘Sikandar’ in 2009, Ayesha took a long break from films. She later featured in the Tamil web series ‘Sweet Kaaram Coffee’, but largely stayed away from the Hindi film industry. Now, reflecting on her journey, the actor has spoken about growing up in the public eye, moving beyond her most recognisable role and wanting to explore different kinds of characters.Ayesha says acting remains her first loveDespite spending years away from the big screen, Ayesha says her passion for acting never disappeared. She continues to enjoy the process of developing a character and collaborating with people on set.Speaking to Hindustan Times, she shared, “It’s great to be acting again. I love acting and the whole process of developing the character, working with the team, and being on set. Acting was my first love, and will always be my first love. I just hope I get more chances to keep working, keep acting, and exploring.”Her career began with ‘Black’, followed by ‘Sikandar’ four years later. She then stepped away from films for several years, a decision that gave her an opportunity to experience life away from the constant attention that came with being a child actor.The shadow of 'Black' stayed with herAyesha's portrayal of young Michelle in ‘Black’ remains one of the most memorable parts of her early career. However, the strong response to the film also meant that audiences continued to associate her closely with the character long after she had moved on.“Yes, it’s been a long break,” the actor admits.Looking back, Ayesha feels the gap also allowed her to return with a different identity. Instead of being viewed only through the lens of her childhood performance, she could now be seen as an adult actor with the freedom to take on roles that reflected where she was in life.“The break definitely allows people to see me as an adult in a film, separately from that girl from Black. Of course, people still remember that for some reason. It’s still in people’s hearts,” she adds.For Ayesha, the long gap has offered an opportunity to return to acting with a fresh perspective. Having started her career as a child, she now hopes to build a body of work that allows audiences to see her beyond the character that made her famous.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more. articles.title: Lluvia de críticas a RTVE por el documental de Lorca que admite una teoría de su muerte descartada por expertos
articles.standfirst: La Asociación Recuperación de la Memoria Histórica ha calificado el documental como "vergonzoso" por "exculpar a los golpistas de 1936"
articles.summary: La Asociación Recuperación de la Memoria Histórica ha calificado el documental como "vergonzoso" por "exculpar a los golpistas de 1936"
articles.body: Federico García Lorca es uno de los enigmas de nuestra época contemporánea. Una pregunta muy recurrente, la de dónde está enterrado el poeta, que en 2026 cumple 90 años de su asesinato y que sigue sin resolverse. Aunque son muchos los años que se han intentado localizar al granadino sin éxito, todos los expertos coinciden en los motivos de su muerte. Todos los expertos o casi todos. Porque en el último documental de RTVE se ha dado voz a una teoría que la propia Asociaición Recuperación de la Memoria Histórica (ARMH) ha calificado directamente de "vergonzosa". Una de las muchas críticas que ha recibido esta crónica visual que la propia asociación asegura que "utiliza el asesinato de Lorca para exculpar a los golpistas de 1936 del inició de la guerra y responsabilizar a la Segunda República". Palabras que van contra este reportaje llamado 'Lorca, las horas perdidas' que fue publicado el pasado viernes 18 de septiembre y que no ha gustado a esta asociación que lanza una frase lapidaria más: "Poniendo en voz de Lorca palabras que nunca dijo para que también haga revisionismo". El documental 'Lorca, las horas perdidas' aborda en formato de true crime los últimos días de Federico García Lorca. La obra investiga los enigmas de su detención y asesinato, analizando las causas, ejecutores, justificaciones y la cronología exacta desde su llegada a Granada hasta su muerte. Mediante recreaciones dramatizadas protagonizadas por Ángel Ruiz y testimonios de destacados historiadores e investigadores, este trabajo propone una nueva mirada histórica sobre uno de los crímenes más emblemáticos e incólumes de la España contemporánea.

articles.body:
Kevin Costner has been romantically linked to lifestyle influencer McKenna Wesley, among other women, following his divorce from Christine Baumgartner.

Costner has been seen with Wesley on multiple occasions, including a lunch outing in Santa Barbara, but neither has publicly confirmed their relationship.

The actor's reported relationship with Wesley has unfolded away from the spotlight, with sources describing their connection as extending beyond public appearances over the past year.

Kevin Costner has reportedly been playing the field since his divorce drama, spending time with an Arizona lifestyle influencer, McKenna Wesley, while being linked to two other women.

The 71-year-old actor and Wesley, 39, have been seen together on several occasions, including a lunch outing in Santa Barbara this summer.

The reported relationship adds another chapter to Kevin Costner's post-divorce love life, which has drawn attention since his split from Christine Baumgartner.

According to sources cited by Page Six , Costner's love life is at an interesting and complex state as he's linked romantically to multiple women.

The actor recently sparked relationship buzz after he was seen being "extremely affectionate" with Jennifer Milburn, a lifestyle coach more than 30 years his junior.

Prior to that, Costner was rumored to be in a casual relationship with 47-year-old socialite Kelly Noonan Gores, the ex-wife of billionaire Alec Gores. Insiders last year even described their connection as incredibly "grounding" for him .

Now, it's been revealed that the Oscar winner has also been spending time with influencer McKenna Wesley, whom he met in Scottsdale, Arizona, about a year ago. The city is Wesley's hometown, and the pair reportedly connected through their shared interest in golf.

"They met in Scottsdale about a year ago. They both love to golf," a source told the news outlet.

The first public sighting came in October 2025, when they were photographed together at a screening of Costner's "Field of Dreams" at Scottsdale Stadium.

Costner hosted the event after the sixth annual Western Wiffle Ball Classic tournament. The appearance did not initially establish a romantic relationship, but the pair have reportedly remained in contact since then.

"She has been his guest on multiple occasions at his Santa Barbara and Aspen properties," another source noted about the pair.

Kevin Costner's Relationship With McKenna Wesley Has Stayed Private

The duo's growing connection has largely unfolded away from the spotlight. According to Page Six , Costner and Wesley have been seen together more than once, but neither has publicly confirmed that they are dating.

They were reportedly spotted having lunch together in Santa Barbara in August, a moment that was captured by a local resident and shared on Instagram.

The sighting added to the indications that their connection had continued beyond their initial Scottsdale appearance.

A representative for Wesley has addressed speculation about her and the Hollywood actor, stating that she "doesn't wish to comment on her relationship with Mr. Costner."

Reps for Costner have yet to respond, leaving the nature of their relationship officially unconfirmed, even as sources describe the two as having spent significant time together over the past year.

The actor's "true" friends reportedly "cut off" Baumgartner after their split.

More About Kevin Costner's Rumored Love Interest, McKenna Wesley

Wesley is described as a lifestyle influencer and content creator who uses the social-media name @thebubblyblonde .

She has 421,000 followers on Instagram and identifies herself as an influencer and lifestyle content creator, with a focus on fashion, beauty, and luxury travel.

She is 39, making her 32 years younger than Costner. Her connection to Arizona is also significant because Scottsdale is where the pair reportedly met and where they were first publicly photographed together.

Beyond their shared interest in golf, little has been publicly established about how the relationship developed.

Neither Costner nor Wesley has offered a detailed account of their private life, and the available reporting comes primarily from sources and public sightings.

The Actor Has Also Been Romantically Linked To Hollywood Stars

The actor, often regarded as one of Hollywood's heartthrobs, has been married twice and has seven children from several relationships.

The recently reported relationship arrives after a turbulent period in Costner's personal life. He divorced his second wife, Christine Baumgartner, following nearly two decades of marriage.

Baumgartner filed for divorce in May 2023, and the divorce was finalized in 2024.

The former couple shares three children: Cayden, Hayes, and Grace. Costner also has four other children from previous relationships, giving him seven children in total.

Besides his rumored romance with Wesley, Milburn and Goores, Costner has also been frequently linked to various women in Hollywood since his divorce.

Last year, he was linked to actress Sharon Stone when insiders claimed that they had a "flirty" interaction at the Governors Awards. He was then said to be getting close to singer Jennifer Lopez after they were briefly spotted together in Aspen. However, these rumors were quickly debunked.

Kevin Costner Continues To Balance His Complex Love Life With His Hollywood Career

Costner's reported connection with Wesley comes as he continues balancing his Hollywood career with a life spread across several properties.

He owns a large ranch in Aspen and a coastal compound in Carpinteria, California, while maintaining ties to Santa Barbara.

His homes provide a natural setting for a relationship that has so far remained private.

articles.title: Ed Sheeran reaparece en solitario en Filadelfia y se derrumba en pleno concierto: "No sabía si me tirarían cosas"
articles.standfirst: El músico de origen irlandés es la primera vez que reaparece sin Macklemore y vuelve a hablar de Gaza
articles.summary: El músico de origen irlandés es la primera vez que reaparece sin Macklemore y vuelve a hablar de Gaza
articles.body: El cantante de origen irlandés Ed Sheeran reapareció este sábado sobre el escenario del Lincoln Financial Field de Filadelfia en un concierto donde todas las miradas estaban puestas en él tras una semana convulsa en su gira norteamericana. Tras la cancelación de la participación del rapero Macklemore por sus declaraciones sobre Palestina —lo que provocó la dimisión en cadena de todo su equipo de teloneros—, Sheeran arrancó su actuación en solitario abordando la crisis humanitaria en Gaza, calificando la situación de "catastrófica e injustificable" y rompiéndose emocionalmente ante miles de fans. "Se ha dicho mucho sobre que los músicos que tocaban antes que yo no estén aquí esta noche, pero también sobre que los músicos con los que solía tocar en el escenario tampoco estén aquí esta noche", comenzó explicando Sheeran sobre el escenario. "Y el espectáculo en sí, a estas alturas del concierto, para ser sincero, normalmente suelo salir a un escenario secundario (B-stage), y voy a ser totalmente sincero con vosotros, no sabía cómo respondería el público esta noche. No sabía si me tirarían cosas. No sabía si la gente me gritaría...", afirmaba con un tono sensible. El cantautor justificó la modificación de la estructura física de su espectáculo por temor a posibles altercados en medio de la pista: "Así que, escuchad, me disculpo porque hoy no ha sido... (se pausaba quebrado) hoy no ha sido el concierto habitual. Quité el escenario secundario porque tenía miedo de lo que pudiera pasar si me ponía en medio, y les habría hecho daño a ellos". Asimismo, relató el desafío que supuso reorganizar el repertorio a escasos días de la fecha programada tras la renuncia de su equipo musical de apoyo: "Así que el concierto es un poco diferente. Pero hay ciertas canciones que simplemente no funcionan con el pedal de loops. Así que, cuando mis amigos se cayeron de este concierto, pensaba: «¿Cómo voy a mantener el espectáculo igual? ¿Y cómo voy a conseguir que haya músicos en el escenario conmigo en una semana en la que nadie quiere subirse a un escenario conmigo?»". Para suplir las ausencias, Sheeran recurrió a colaboraciones de emergencia organizadas a contrarreloj: "Y llamé a una amiga mía que es soberbia. Es un ser humano soberbio, estuve de gira con ella todo el año pasado, todo el año anterior y el anterior a ese. Y le dije: «¿Te subirías al escenario conmigo?». Y me dijo que sí. Y le pregunté si conocía a amigos músicos y me dijo que sí. Y han tenido tres días para aprenderse estas canciones, ¡tres días para aprenderse estas canciones!", repitió para enfatizar lo que eran palabras de agradecimiento. El británico concluyó su intervención agradeciendo la valentía de los instrumentistas que aceptaron acompañarle a pesar del clima de controversia pública: "Y solo quiero decir, antes de que salgan al escenario, que dijeron que sí a estar en el escenario con el conocimiento de que el mundo pensaba que yo era cierto tipo de persona. Dijeron que sí sabiendo que el mundo también podría odiarles a ellos por estar en el escenario conmigo. Y estoy tan agradecido... Así que quiero dar la bienvenida a Mike a la batería, a Sunjay a los teclados, a Eric al bajo, a Claire a la guitarra y a mi queridísima amiga Alicia al violín. Por favor, haced ruido".

articles.title: Prince Harry’s push to give Archie, Lilibet royal upbringing exposes ‘contradiction’ after palace exit: expert
articles.summary: Prince Harry's children started school in England as experts question whether he can mend the rift with King Charles and Prince William first.
articles.body: Prince Harry wants his children to embrace their British roots and royal heritage, but one expert says there's a glaring "contradiction." "Harry spent years telling us why he needed to escape royal life, said his father and brother were trapped, but now appears determined to make sure his children understand and retain their connection to it," Kinsey Schofield, host of YouTube's "Kinsey Schofield Unfiltered," told Fox News Digital. "Perhaps with time and distance, he has realized that walking away from royal duties was much easier than walking away from the history, family and identity that came with them," Schofield said. "Ultimately, Harry may finally be recognizing what has always seemed so obvious to the rest of us — being born a prince is an unbelievable privilege." PRINCE HARRY, MEGHAN MARKLE’S UK MOVE PUTS FRESH SPOTLIGHT ON THEIR EXPLOSIVE CLAIMS AGAINST ROYAL FAMILY On Aug. 20, it was announced that Harry and his wife, Meghan Markle, had decided to return to the U.K. for an extended stay beginning this fall, but they would not resume their roles as working royals. Their children, Prince Archie, 7, and Princess Lilibet, 5, recently started school in England. A source told People magazine that Harry "wants them to understand the world he grew up in and where their family comes from." Fox News Digital reached out to Archewell, which handles the offices of the Duke and Duchess of Sussex, for comment. "It is totally understandable that Harry wants Archie and Lilibet to grow up appreciating their British heritage, traditions and knowing their extended family," British royals expert Hilary Fordwich told Fox News Digital. "But after all he has said and done, it's highly unlikely the family will ever trust Harry or welcome them all back into the family fold." WATCH: PRINCE HARRY WANTS HIS CHILDREN TO EMBRACE ENGLISH HERITAGE: EXPERT "It would have been surprising if he felt California was like home or in any way comparable to anything his children could experience in the U.K.," Fordwich argued. "He has expressed wanting his children to understand their paternal history." The Duke and Duchess of Sussex stepped back as working royals and moved to California more than six years ago. They later signed lucrative contracts with Netflix and Spotify as they sought to become financially independent. In a series of interviews and Harry's memoir "Spare," the couple said they left Britain to escape the restrictions of royal life and criticized palace officials for being insensitive to Meghan's mental health while alleging that at least one member of the royal family had expressed racist views when she was pregnant with their first child. Meghan, a former actress, is biracial. Although relations with some members of the royal family have soured since then, Harry told the BBC in 2025 that he wanted to reconcile with his family. In the same interview, however, Harry said he could not envision bringing Meghan and their children back to the U.K. because of concerns over their security. His father, King Charles III, continues to receive treatment for an undisclosed form of cancer. "Harry and Meghan want their children to build close relationships with their cousins, in fact, the whole British royal family," British broadcaster and photographer Helena Chard told Fox News Digital. "Allegedly, this was one of the deciding factors in their U.K. return. It is understandable at this point why the family will keep their distance from the Sussexes. Harry and Meghan, for their children's sake, should work towards peace with the family. Not just a sweeping statement about reconciliation and doing the exact opposite. But Harry will absolutely want his children to understand their heritage and that they are part of the British royal family." GET ENTERTAINMENT SCOOP DELIVERED RIGHT TO YOUR EMAIL BY CLICKING HERE A source told People magazine that the family's decision to leave California for an extended period wasn't easy for Meghan. "They've been planning this for some time, and they feel it's the right thing for their family, but that doesn't mean leaving was easy," the insider explained to the outlet. "Meghan really loves their life in Montecito and their home there. They know it's going to take a little bit of time for everyone to settle in and adjust. There's excitement about what's ahead too, especially for the kids. They're really happy for them, and for everything they'll get to experience." Schofield noted that Harry was eager for his children to have a closer relationship with their grandfather despite tensions within the royal family. "I think Harry has reached a point where he recognizes that Britain is a huge part of his children's identity," Schofield said. "Archie and Lili are grandchildren of the king. Their grandfather is on the currency. Their uncle will be king. Their cousins are the future of the monarchy. They would be given privileges and opportunities in the U.K. that they simply wouldn't attract in the States." "I think Harry wants to reopen the royal door, but perhaps on his own terms," Schofield continued. "The problem is that the monarchy has never operated that way. Harry may want his children to enjoy the history, relationships and privileges that come with being part of the royal family while maintaining the independence he chose in 2020. That tension has been at the heart of this story from the very beginning." LIKE WHAT YOU'RE READING? If Harry genuinely wants Archie and Lilibet to understand their royal heritage, eventually he has to confront the fact that his children barely know the relatives who embody it." Archie was a baby when his parents left the U.K. in 2020. Lilibet was born in California in 2021. Before this year's relocation, their last visit to the U.K. was in July for a private family trip that included a reunion with the king at Highgrove House. Before that, the children had not visited the U.K. since June 2022 for Queen Elizabeth II's Platinum Jubilee. A source told People magazine that Harry and his father spoke by phone during the Duke of Sussex's first week back in the U.K. The two have yet to meet in person again since the Sussexes returned on Aug. 26. Multiple royal experts told Fox News Digital that Harry and his older brother, Prince William, haven't spoken since 2022. "Harry cannot expect the children to repair what the adults have broken," Schofield said. "Any meaningful relationships between the cousins would require trust between their parents first." "Prince William is going to prioritize his three children, Prince George, Princess Charlotte and Prince Louis, and their privacy. If Harry wants those relationships for his children, rebuilding trust with William becomes increasingly important. And I do think that burden is on Harry. Any pressure on Prince William to reconcile is wildly unfair." Still, Chard noted that children could help soften strained relationships between family members and "serve as a bridge." articles.body: Bhojpuri actress Kajal Raghwani had a frightening experience in Bihar Sharif when a massive crowd of fans chased her car after a jewellery showroom inauguration. The actress has since assured everyone that she is safe, even as police raise questions about the event's permission.Fans swarm actress's car in Bihar SharifAccording to the India Today report, Kajal Raghwani had travelled to Bihar Sharif to open a jewellery showroom, where a large number of people had gathered to get a glimpse of her. The situation reportedly turned chaotic as she was being escorted away from the venue. A video going around on social media shows a big group of people running behind the car in which she was travelling. The crowd allegedly broke the glass of a car, thinking she was inside. Several windows of her Toyota Fortuner were damaged in the incident.Showroom operator helps her leaveThe showroom operator helped Kajal Raghwani exit quietly as the crowd kept growing. She was brought out through the driver's gate, after which the vehicle sped away from the location. The video also captured people running after the vehicle as it tried to make its way through the gathering.Kajal Raghwani says she is fineLater, Kajal Raghwani shared a video on social media to tell her fans that she was safe and unharmed. She thanked her supporters and requested them to keep backing her.Permission dispute between police and organisersAs per reports, police said the event did not have administrative permission and that a notice would be sent to the organisers. However, the showroom operator reportedly disputed this claim. articles.body: Diljit Dosanjh continues to expand his global footprint, with his recent performance at London’s Wembley Stadium becoming another major milestone in his international career. The Punjabi singer-actor performed before a crowd of nearly 90,000 on September 12 as part of his Aura World Tour. Reacting to the achievement, Ranveer Allahbadia praised Diljit for taking Indian music to international audiences and described his journey as an example of what humility, faith and hard work can achieve.Ranveer Allahbadia calls Diljit’s Wembley performance a moment of prideIn a video shared on Instagram, Ranveer Allahbadia spoke about the significance of Diljit headlining one of the world’s most recognised stadiums. He noted that Wembley has hosted some of the biggest names in international music, including Taylor Swift, Beyonce, Harry Styles and Michael Jackson, and highlighted Diljit’s entry into that league of performers.“The whole of India should be standing and applauding this man,” Ranveer said while reflecting on Diljit’s journey from Punjabi entertainment to becoming an internationally recognised artiste.Diljit made history with the Wembley concert as the first Punjabi artiste to headline the iconic London venue. For Ranveer, the achievement represents more than just a successful concert, as he believes it reflects the growing international reach of Indian artistes.Ranveer compares Wembley milestone with Bollywood box-office numbersRanveer also questioned why large achievements in live music do not always receive the same attention as blockbuster film collections. Drawing a comparison with the way Bollywood celebrates major box-office figures, he pointed out the scale of Diljit’s Wembley audience.“We celebrate 100 crore films so much,” he said, stressing that selling 90,000 tickets for a concert at one of the world’s most prominent stadiums is itself a significant commercial and cultural achievement.He further said that Diljit’s journey could eventually be remembered as one of the notable artistic success stories of the post-Independence era. “This is proof of what humility, faith and sheer hard work can build in one lifetime,” Ranveer said.He concluded his tribute by thanking Diljit for his contribution to Indian music’s international presence and for “taking India to the world.”Diljit performs popular tracks and pays tribute to Nusrat Fateh Ali KhanDiljit’s Wembley set featured several of his popular songs, including “GOAT”, “Lover”, “Hass Hass” and “Born to Shine”. He also performed “Sanson Ki Mala Pe” as a tribute to legendary Pakistani musician Nusrat Fateh Ali Khan. Videos from the performance have since gained significant attention online.For Diljit, the Wembley concert was equally meaningful. The singer has described the show as a dream come true and thanked his fans after the performance, calling it the beginning of a new chapter.From Coachella to Wembley, Diljit’s international journeyThe Wembley achievement adds to a series of international milestones in Diljit Dosanjh’s career. In 2023, he became the first Punjabi artiste to perform at Coachella. The following year, he made his debut on The Tonight Show Starring Jimmy Fallon and also became the first South Asian artiste to feature on the cover of Billboard magazine.With each of these milestones, Diljit has continued to take Punjabi music and Indian popular culture to audiences beyond the country. The clip was recorded while 'Bigg Boss 20' was on air, at the point when Salman took off his shirt on television.Salman removes shirt to challenge trollsOn stage, Salman took off his hat and shirt and asked people who have been trolling him over his weight and appearance to take a look at him now. He declared, "Bhai mota hogaya hai, bhai ko troll karo… Karlo troll, yeh lo. Karlo troll. Aao, troll karna hai na? Troll karna pasand hai? Yeh dekho, close-up karlo (Salman has put on weight; go ahead and troll him... Go on, troll away—here you go. Troll him. Come on, you want to troll, right? You enjoy trolling? Look at this, get a close-up)."Salman Khan calls out paparazziSalman also spoke against photographers who click actors from angles that make them uncomfortable, particularly from behind. He questioned why such pictures are taken and how they are then presented on social media. Speaking about the practice, Salman said, "And then the one shot they take from behind, which none of the heroines like? There must be a few who say it's okay, I don't mind it. articles.title: Fantasy doesn’t need another 'Game of Thrones.' It needs what Tolkien understood
articles.summary: Tolkien and Lewis never confused darkness with goodness, yet modern fantasy from "Game of Thrones" to YA books trades wonder for explicit content.
articles.body: Tales of dragons, noble kings, evil empires, heroic quests and the battle between light and darkness have captured imaginations across cultures for years. We’re drawn to the adventure of legends and lore because something deep inside us longs to be filled with wonder. Our hearts ache to know that courage still means something, that love is worth fighting for and that the world holds more mystery than the mundanity of our daily routines. Tolkien and Lewis understood this and built Middle-earth and Narnia as entire worlds where wonder and danger were intertwined, and courage was meaningful because it came at a cost. Their books are still adored generations later because they never confused darkness with goodness. Today, the epic fantasy genre is more popular than ever, with audiences spending billions annually consuming comics, toys, books, movies and video games. But much of it betrays what made it great. RUSSELL CROWE SAYS 'GLADIATOR II' FAILED BECAUSE IT LACKED ORIGINAL FILM'S 'MORAL CORE' Somewhere in recent years, creators began to confuse being mature with being explicit, turning the industry into a clickbait factory pumping out gratuitous sex and violence to lure eyeballs and dollars. Even worse, the industry seems to be trying to sneak it all in under parents’ noses. Pick up one of the best-selling fantasy series of the last few years and you will likely find yourself in a world the cover never warned you about. "A Court of Thorns and Roses" and "Fourth Wing" are marketed as young adult fiction in stores and school libraries despite graphic content throughout — part of the trend toward darker and more explicit YA publishing. The "Game of Thrones" universe shows where that trajectory ends. The book series alone portrays 214 separate acts of rape across 117 named victims, and a survey of the show’s own viewers concluded its pervasive sexual violence served no purpose in the story at all. WE SHOULD TELL REAL AMERICAN ADVENTURE STORIES TO TEACH OUR BOYS ABOUT HEROES The smut is a distraction from the good of fantasy: the imagined worlds, heroes and adventures that call its fans to a higher ethos. The question, then, is not whether evil exists, but whether fantasy creators ask their video game players to fight it or practice it, whether fantasy authors craft stories that expose darkness or train an audience to enjoy it. This does not mean every creature, battle, or supernatural power is evil. The Bible is full of supernatural events. It contains war, betrayal, demons, giants, dragons, sorcery and miracles. "The Lord of the Rings" depicts monsters, magic, death, corruption and the temptation of power. But these stories make clear that evil has consequences, courage matters and darkness is never confused with goodness. Children who read the "Chronicles of Narnia" must confront serious themes of deception, sacrifice and death, yet come to understand that goodness is worth dying for. DIRECTOR OF NEW ‘LORD OF THE RINGS’ REJECTS ‘POLITICALLY CORRECT’ CASTING AFTER SUGGESTIONS FILM IS TOO WHITE And these are some of the best-selling titles of all time. Clearly, fantasy fans want danger, powerful enemies, imperfect characters, adventure, wonder, humor and hope. But do we really want our 15-year-olds engrossed in pornography, vulgarity, hopelessness or stories that present evil as good? It would be easy to hear all of this and assume the answer is to steer strictly toward faith-based and conservative entertainment. Yet conservative or Christian creators must also do better. Audiences expect excellent writing, acting, music, visuals and production. Traditional or even Christian values cannot save a boring story, uninspiring characters, unconvincing worlds or bad gameplay. CLICK HERE FOR MORE FOX NEWS OPINION Tolkien and Lewis did not build Middle Earth or Narnia as a sermon in disguise. The truth inside their worlds came alive because the craft came first. That is the standard worth chasing. Not just a cleaner version of what already exists, but a new golden age of fantasy, written by authors, filmmakers and studios — Christian and secular alike — willing to do the harder work of making something genuinely good. CLICK HERE TO DOWNLOAD THE FOX NEWS APP To every storyteller reading this: the desire for wonder without wreckage is enormous. We need to craft worlds worth losing ourselves in for an afternoon, with heroes worth following into the dark because we trust they’re going to lead us back into the light. We need to remember what made fantasy worth loving in the first place and go write it again.

articles.title: Alix Earle’s stepmom owns ‘reckless’ past, from Spitzer escort scandal to affair with influencer’s dad
articles.summary: Alix Earle's stepmother Ashley Dupré details her role in the Eliot Spitzer scandal and affair with TJ Earle in a revealing new essay for Elle.
articles.body: Ashley Dupré isn’t running from her "reckless" past anymore. Alix Earle’s stepmother opened up about the choices that once made her tabloid fodder, including her connection to the Eliot Spitzer prostitution scandal and her affair with the influencer’s married father. Alix, 25, shot to fame on TikTok and has built a massive following by sharing her life online – including, at times, the complicated family history that played out in the tabloids when she was a child. Ashley was thrust into the national spotlight in 2008 when she was identified as an escort connected to then-New York Gov. Eliot Spitzer in the prostitution scandal that preceded his resignation. "At 19, while working as a cocktail waitress, a man approached me and told me I could make $1,000 an hour going on dates with high-profile men," she wrote in an essay for Elle. "My first answer was no, but I kept his card. Eventually, I made the call. I could spend paragraphs explaining why. I was young. I wanted money and independence. I’d spent years operating in survival mode and had become very good at compartmentalizing. But ultimately, I made the call. It was my decision." ALIX EARLE SPOTTED DANCING WITH TOM BRADY IN ST. BARTS: WHAT TO KNOW ABOUT THE SOCIAL MEDIA SENSATION According to Ashley, she managed the work for two years without anyone knowing. "Then, when I was 22, the FBI knocked on my door and showed me a photograph of a man I had seen," she explained. "I didn’t know who he was. When they told me he was the governor of New York, I couldn’t begin to understand what was about to happen." What followed was a level of attention Ashley said she never could have anticipated. "Soon, my stage name and face were on the front page of The New York Post. There was an almost ridiculous irony to it," she recalled. "I had come to New York City wanting to be noticed, and suddenly everyone noticed me – for the one thing I never wanted anyone to know." ‘DUCK DYNASTY’ STAR SADIE ROBERTSON HUFF ADMITS ‘FEARS’ OVER PUTTING HER KIDS ON REALITY TV Ashley said she can now look back at that period without minimizing the role she played. "Context isn’t absolution. I made choices. Some were reckless," she wrote. "Some were selfish. They had consequences. I can own all of that without believing those choices have to be the most interesting thing about me forever." Ashley's affair with TJ hit the tabloids in 2008, months after she made headline news with the Spitzer scandal. The two had met by chance at a restaurant in New Jersey and things escalated from there. "We talked for five or six hours, and our connection was immediate," Ashley recalled. "TJ was married," she admitted. "We crossed a line we shouldn’t have crossed, and I take responsibility for my part in that. Our choices affected and hurt other people, including his wife, Alisa, and daughters, Alix and Ashtin, and I don’t take that lightly." Alix was just a child when the affair turned her family life into tabloid news. GET ENTERTAINMENT SCOOP DELIVERED RIGHT TO YOUR EMAIL BY CLICKING HERE "I remember the day very clearly," Alix said on a 2023 episode of "Call Her Daddy." "Paparazzi had shown up at my house and my mom quickly kind of got me and my sister out of the house over to our cousins. We stayed there for a few days and I had no idea what was going on. I didn't know they were paparazzi. I thought news broadcasters were interviewing the neighbors." While Alix was too young to understand what was happening at the time, she later discovered who Ashley was. "It was in like fourth grade," she told host Alex Cooper. "I started to kind of hear commentary from people and I had an iPad at the time. I'm Googling my family and, all of a sudden, I see that the past two years of my life had been a lie." LIKE WHAT YOU'RE READING? CLICK HERE FOR MORE ENTERTAINMENT NEWS "My dad had an affair with someone who was well-known for her job having sexual relations with high-class people and one of them was even the governor of New York," Alix said. "She was very well-known from that and, in turn, my dad's affair became a very public situation." Ashley and TJ later married in 2013. But the fallout followed Alix beyond her family’s front door and into her childhood. Friends often weren't allowed to come over to her home. "The parents would kind of tell my mom, and she would tell me kind of the harsh truth of why this can't happen," she said. "She would have to sit me down and be like, 'They don't really respect us.'" Behind closed doors, Alix was also grappling with her father's new relationship. "When my stepmom started to hang around with my dad after he had moved out, she came into his life, and we were introduced to her, which was super weird," Alix explained. "And I was told that I had to be respectful to this woman, and we had to be nice to her. I wanted to rip her head off. It was very weird because I felt like I was a 10-year-old having to be more mature than someone 20, 30 years older than me." PUT YOUR ENTERTAINMENT KNOWLEDGE TO THE TEST AND SEE HOW YOU SCORE Despite their difficult beginning, Ashley eventually became a permanent part of the Earle family. Their relationship evolved in the years that followed, as Ashley and TJ built a life together. Nearly two decades later, Ashley said she no longer feels the need to convince the world that she is more than her past. "Twenty years ago, I wanted everyone to understand me. Today, I don’t," Ashley wrote. "The people sitting around my dinner table know who I am. So do I." "I’m not ashamed of the young woman I was," Ashley added. "I wouldn’t make all of her choices again, but I’m also done wishing her away. She was ambitious, reckless, complicated and sometimes very wrong. But she kept going." "We live in a culture that can preserve a person’s worst moment forever," she mused. "Accountability matters, but so does allowing people to grow. If we believe that no one can become more than the bad decision they made at 19 or 22, then we leave very little room for any of us to change." CLICK HERE TO DOWNLOAD THE FOX NEWS APP

articles.title: 'Neem Karoli Baba's daughter has watched Hanuman Ansh 15 times and cried each time,' says producer Ragini Sona: 'We saw that she is a total replica of Baba'
articles.summary: ‘Hanuman Ansh’ has found an unexpected audience at the box office, with the film reportedly earning over Rs 329.30 crore worldwide. Producer Ragini So.
articles.body: ‘Hanuman Ansh’ has found an unexpected audience at the box office, with the film reportedly earning over Rs 329.30 crore worldwide. Producer Ragini Sona believes the film’s journey and success have been closely connected to the blessings of Neem Karoli Baba. Ragini opened up about her meeting with Baba’s daughter, Girija ji (Amma ji), before the film’s release and recalled an experience she described as nothing short of a miracle.Ragini revealed that she and director Vishal Chaturvedi had made efforts to meet Girija ji and seek her blessings before the film hit theatres. Recalling their first interaction, she said in an interview with Screen, “I met Neem Karoli Baba’s daughter, Girija ji. We tried to find her contact number and went to meet her because Vishal (Chaturvedi) also wanted us to seek her blessings once. There was a phone conversation between the three of us, Amma ji, Vishal and me, where we asked her if she would like to see the film. And she said, ‘Yes, I will watch the film when I feel that the time is right.’ As of today, Baba’s daughter has watched the film around 15 times, and she has cried each time.”The meeting became even more significant for Ragini when Girija ji asked her about the reason behind making the film. Ragini shared her childhood experience of meeting Neem Karoli Baba, while Vishal spoke about the research that went into the project. She recalled, “Then she asked, ‘Please tell me, what inspired you to make this film?’ I shared my experience of meeting Neem Karoli Baba at the age of six. Vishal shared what led him to make this film, and spoke about his research. I said, ‘Amma ji, my father was posted in Nainital.’ Nobody will believe this, but because Vishal was there on the call, he is a witness to this miracle. Amma ji immediately took my father’s name, shared the exact location of my father’s home in Agra, and this is some 50-year-old news. Amma ji said that she could see everything in front of her eyes in real time. She also took my older brother’s name. I can’t think of a miracle greater than this.”The producer said the incident left her emotional and strengthened her belief that she had been chosen to be part of the project. Ragini further recalled, “I was crying and asked her, ‘How do you know all of this?’ To which, Amma ji replied, ‘I don’t have any answers to your question, but I could see everything.’ After all, she is Baba ji‘s daughter, and after this experience, I was assured that I was picked by Baba to be a part of this magnitude.”Ragini also spoke about meeting Girija ji personally and noticing how deeply she continues to follow Neem Karoli Baba’s teachings. She said, “Before making the film, we didn’t even know that Baba’s daughter was still around. And when we met her, we saw that she is a total replica of Baba. I felt like it was Baba himself in her. She also abides by Baba’s teachings, ‘Love all, feed all.’ The food we had at her place tasted so divine, and its quantity would automatically increase. I could very strongly feel Baba’s presence there,” recalled the producer.The team later met Neem Karoli Baba’s grandson, Dhananjan ji, as well. Ragini described the family as humble and said they were grateful to have received their blessings. “Very recently, we also met Baba’s grandson, Dhananjan ji. They are such simple people, just like Baba. They are very loving people, and we are grateful to Baba ji that these people are still among us and that we received all their blessings,” she said.Highlighting the message that continues to be carried forward by Baba’s family, Ragini added, “‘Love all, feed all’ was his message, and his entire family carries that message with them. My naman (bowing down with respect) to Dhananjan ji as well because they are the actual Ansh (fragments) of Baba,” Ragini added.The producer also acknowledged Virat Kohli and Anushka Sharma for helping bring Neem Karoli Baba into the curiosity of a younger audience. According to Ragini, their association with Baba encouraged more people to learn about him. She said, “Virat Kohli and Anushka Sharma played a significant role in sparking public curiosity about Baba. I am sure that they also must have experienced something life-changing, but many times, people aren’t vocal about it because it can’t be expressed in words, just felt. Now, this film is a medium for people to know Baba because nobody had told his story yet,” she said.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more. articles.title: A24’s reputation is on the line with the SCP Foundation movie
articles.summary: A24’s V/H/S: SCP movie is already on shaky ground after potentially running afoul of Creative Commons licensing rules.
articles.body: After the success of Backrooms, it looks like A24 is trying to cash in on yet another internet horror craze with a new installment in the V/H/S horror anthology series set in the SCP Foundation universe. But as soon as it was announced, the backlash started, and V/H/S: SCP already appears to be on shaky ground. SCP is a creepypasta that, like Backrooms, originated on 4chan. The fictional SCP (Special Containment Procedures) Foundation documents, captures, and contains paranormal or supernatural anomalies. It’s a sprawling story told primarily through wiki entries that mimic documentation you might file while working at a government agency. It’s sci-fi cosmic horror by way of bureaucratic nightmares. It’s the sort of material ripe for a monster-of-the-week style anthology. But, unlike Backrooms where A24 worked with the creator of a YouTube series popular within the Backrooms community, it does not appear as if the studio tried to engage the SCP community at all. The SCP Foundation Wiki, the official home for all things SCP, posted a statement following the announcement of the film that read, “We have not had any communication with the filmmakers, producers, or distributors for this project, despite our best efforts, and to the best of our knowledge they have not made any efforts to contact us.” DrEverettMann, an SCP Foundation Wiki Admin, told The Verge that, “We have made several attempts to contact them since the announcement of the project but haven’t received a response.” This isn’t just about generating goodwill with fans, either. SCP is an organized community effort with licensing rules. The SCP Foundation is organized under a Creative Commons license, specifically CC BY-SA 3.0, a ShareAlike license. That means, while anyone can distribute or create works based on SCP, it must also allow anyone to copy, redistribute, or create derivative works based on theirs. That would make making money on a feature film extremely difficult. A24 made several serious missteps following the release of Backrooms, angering fans by filing copyright claims against other Backrooms creators, before withdrawing them after director Kane Parsons intervened. So, A24 and its partners at Image Nation Studios and Spooky Pictures have been eager to clarify that they are not asserting exclusive rights to the SCP universe. A24 declined to comment, but Monique Levine, a spokesperson for Image Nation and Spooky, told The Verge that “A24’s worldwide rights pertain to the specific film project being produced.” The problem is, under the license used by the SCP Foundation, nobody can claim exclusive rights to any SCP material. Creative Commons’ CEO Anna Tumadóttir told The Verge that, “Anyone can use works available under Creative Commons ShareAlike (CC BY-SA) license, even commercially,” but that, “Adaptations must be released under the same terms as the original,” and “unless a separate agreement is reached with the copyright holders, a studio-produced film like this would need to be released under CC BY-SA 3.0 or a compatible later version, with attribution to the original creators, and without exclusive distribution rights. Anyone else would remain free to redistribute or stream it under the same terms.” As Paul Szynol, a law professor at the University of Michigan and Villanova, told The Verge, while “anyone — A24, Netflix as well as you, me, and all of our cousins” are free to make an SCP film and release it in theatres, “the studio wouldn’t be able to stop anyone else from making adaptations of its film,” or redistributing it. And, as he points out, that “would be an extremely unusual business model for a major studio.” SCP’s DrEverettMann agreed. The license “wouldn’t prevent the film from being shown in theaters, nor would it prevent theaters from charging admission as usual,” he said. But “whether it would be practical to release the film under traditional distribution methods is a trickier question.” Mann expanded, “The fact that anyone is able to distribute a CC BY-SA-licensed work means that the usual theatrical exclusivity wouldn’t apply. It is not possible for anybody to have exclusive rights to a film distributed under a CC BY-SA license … We don’t know how many people would choose to pay to see a film in theaters when they could legally download it at home for free.” This leaves A24 with a few options. It could simply carry forward with the project as is and worry about the legal problems later. But as Tumadóttir points out, “CC licenses, including ShareAlike, have been enforced in courts around the world, when needed.” And Szynol concurs, saying, “In that case, A24’s version of the film would be unauthorized and infringing. Basically, it would be the death of the project.” It seems more likely that A24 and Spooky Pictures will abandon the SCP branding, while still taking “inspiration” from the source material. It’s a tactic others have taken with commercial works, like with the novel There is No Antimemetics Division written by SCP Foundation contributor QNTM. Another option would be to release the movie under the ShareAlike license and hope that it could still recoup production costs even without being able to claim rights. It would be the boldest move, but perhaps the least likely outcome.

articles.title: Don’t forget to laugh: Hasan Minhaj won’t forget joy in difficult stories
articles.summary: When he was growing up, Hasan Minhaj’s father told him to separate his Muslim background from his career.
articles.body: When he was growing up, Hasan Minhaj’s father told him to separate his Muslim background from his career. Years later, the comedian and actor has done exactly the opposite. In an interview with “Meet with Press,” Minhaj reflected on how his upbringing as a Muslim and the child of Indian immigrants has been infused into his work. The comedian particularly recalled hosting the 2017 White House Correspondents’ Association dinner and seeing his father in the audience. “I couldn’t have been more proud to be his son in that moment. I felt like, ‘Man, I hope you’re proud, and I hope you’re seeing that the house I grew up in, and the way we would talk about politics and the world, all of that influenced what I’m doing now,’” Minhaj said. Minhaj praised New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani, saying that it’s been an “incredible moment” to see the city’s first Muslim mayor in office. “In the past, the way politics was kind of navigated was vis-à-vis this kind of negotiation. You give a little, give and take, be practical. And I think here in New York City, we got to witness, ‘Hey, I’m going to do it my way,’” Minhaj said. “What if I win, lose or draw, start a campaign literally from Jackson Heights, from Queens, from the forgotten boroughs of this city?” Minhaj said Mamdani’s campaign reflects how “so many great stories are taken from the margins to the mainstream.” “What’s beautiful about this moment is this is a moment for a lot of us to walk and act with moral clarity. ‘Hey, I’m not compromising my core beliefs. I’m walking through with this with clarity,’” Minhaj said. Minhaj said that his identity and experiences inspired his latest project, a film he co-wrote and stars in called “Best of the Best,” which follows two childhood best friends as they join their university’s competitive Bollywood dance team. “So for me this is a love letter to my community. It’s a love letter to my upbringing,” Minhaj said of the film. “I’ve been asked this question, ‘How did you come up with this world?’ And the crazy part is I didn’t. This world actually literally exists.” Minhaj said one concept that he sought to articulate in the film is “izzat,” a Hindi word that means dignity and self-respect, a notion that he referenced as a response to Islamophobia. He said when interviewing fellow comedian Kumail Nanjiani recently, Minhaj asked him whether he felt American, to which Nanjiani said, “It’s not about how I feel. It’s about the way the country sees me.” “Your belonging in a group is about the way the group sees you. I thought that was really powerful,” Minhaj said. “Izzat,” instead, means “it doesn’t matter what other people think of you,” Minhaj said. “I think about my grandmother, who raised me. She literally went to school under British colonial rule in British Civil Lines. So she was not seen as a whole person,” he continued. “And she persevered despite that.” Asked by moderator Kristen Welker about his own experience with Islamophobia, Minhaj said that he was “lucky I have this amazing platform.” “I think about the taxicab driver. I think about the people who are being snatched up and detained by ICE. I’m thinking about the Senegalese immigrant who is waiting for his green card to go through,” Minhaj said. Minhaj told Welker that while he’s worked through several mediums, from talk shows to film to podcasts, “comedy feels the most at home.” He said that while covering heavy topics, it’s essential to still prioritize laughter. “Inherent within politics are obviously horrible things: war, destruction, famine, genocide,” Minhaj said. “I also want to say that isn’t what entirely makes us human. Laughter, joy and love are also part of the human experience.”

articles.body: Mahabharat actor and wrestler Saurav Gurjar is in judicial custody after a woman filed a complaint against him in Mumbai. She has alleged that he deceived and harassed her after promising to marry her. Gachibowli police have registered a case and are investigating.What the woman has allegedIndia Today reported that according to the complaint, the woman came to know Gurjar through Instagram in 2021, and the two grew close over WhatsApp. She alleged that they met in person for the first time on December 25, 2021, and that he promised to marry her and give her the rights of a wife.She further alleged that they lived together while she was in the United States and again after she returned to India. She claimed he convinced her to quit her job in the US by promising that they would start a business together.The woman also alleged that his behaviour left her unable to focus on her career. articles.summary: Aaron Rodgers says he regretted letting now-wife Brittani go years earlier, revealing the secret timeline from their 2017 meeting to their 2025 elopement.
articles.body: Aaron Rodgers’ love life has taken him from Hollywood romances and a broken engagement to a secret wedding years in the making. Rodgers’ road to marriage was anything but a straight line. After high-profile romances with Olivia Munn, Danica Patrick and Shailene Woodley, the NFL star ultimately found his way back to the woman he says he regretted letting go years earlier. The now 42-year-old football star's dating life began drawing celebrity-media attention in the late 2000s and early 2010s. Actress Jessica Szohr was among his earliest well-documented Hollywood connections, but his relationships became substantially more public once he began dating Munn in 2014. AARON RODGERS MAKES BOMBSHELL CLAIMS ABOUT SHAILENE WOODLEY SPLIT Jessica Szohr The "Gossip Girl" star and Rodgers had an on-and-off relationship in the early 2010s. Szohr and the quarterback were first linked in 2011, after being spotted publicly together. The former couple initially ended things because of their busy schedules. The two reportedly rekindled their relationship in 2014 before calling it quits again. Their romance preceded Rodgers’ more heavily publicized relationships, and the pair appeared to remain on friendly terms afterward. While there aren't many public details about the couple's rumored relationship, People reported Szohr later attended Rodgers’ birthday party in 2017. GET ENTERTAINMENT SCOOP DELIVERED RIGHT TO YOUR EMAIL BY CLICKING HERE Olivia Munn Rodgers met Olivia Munn while presenting the Song of the Year award at the ACM Awards in 2014. Their relationship quickly became one of his most high-profile romances. While both had busy schedules, Munn explained how the two made it work. "There’s a lot of traveling, a lot of driving, and then you’re just really happy with the decisions that you make. And for me, it comes at a time in my life when I end up having to say no to some work because I gotta be somewhere else. It doesn’t make me sad or anything, because I want my life to be full and have all those experiences, so you kind of figure it out as you go," she told E! News in 2014. Engagement rumors between the two began to surface in 2016 and Munn even stepped out with a ruby on her ring finger. However, the two called it quits just a few months later. "When you are living out a relationship in the public eye, it’s definitely … it’s difficult. It has some extra constraints, because you have other opinions about your relationship, how it affects your work and, you know, just some inappropriate connections," Rodgers told ESPN shortly after the breakup. During their relationship, it became public that Rodgers was estranged from his family, and many of his fans blamed Munn for the rift. "There's this whole big narrative that stayed with me for so many years, but there was just this dynamic in the family that had nothing to do with me. It became this whole big thing, and people were like, "I can't with her, she's keeping this family apart,'" Munn said during a 2025 appearance on the "Armchair Expert" podcast. In Ian O'Connor’s 2024 biography "Out of the Darkness: The Mystery of Aaron Rodgers," Rodgers shared that the cause of the schism was "deep-rooted." He also clarified that Munn "had nothing to do all the years" of prior estrangement. LIKE WHAT YOU'RE READING? CLICK HERE FOR MORE ENTERTAINMENT NEWS Danica Patrick Rodgers traded Hollywood glamour for racing royalty when he began dating Danica Patrick. The former IndyCar and NASCAR star confirmed their romance in January 2018, years after the two had initially crossed paths at the ESPYs. The two had actually kept in touch via email before sparks flew. "We kept in touch a little bit, and there were some years we didn’t talk to each other, and then some every now and again, but it wasn’t until obviously recently that we actually had phone numbers. We referred to each other as Chicago and Green Bay – it was very cute," Patrick told Jenny McCarthy on her SiriusXM show. The relationship quickly became serious and highly visible, with the pair making public appearances and Rodgers openly discussing their life together. "We’re just two people who enjoy being around each other and love each other," he told Artful Living in 2018. "We’re really into each other … we’re really attracted to each other … we really enjoy traveling … She’s up for anything travel-wise, which is fun. She’s a good travel partner because she’s so laid-back and low-maintenance. And she’s a hell of a cook, so we love just staying in, too. She eats really healthy. She’s inspired me in that way." But there would be no trip down the aisle: after more than two years as a couple, Patrick's representative confirmed their split in July 2020. In a 2025 appearance on "The Sage Steele Show," Patrick spoke about her time with Rodgers, claiming that "the nature of the relationship was emotionally abusive." "He leaves a trail of blood," she said, later adding, "It gave me the greatest gift, the greatest gift, which is myself. It gave me the greatest gift of how much I needed to show up for myself and take care of myself." On a recent episode of "Not Just Football with Cam Heyward," Rodgers shared his side of the story, saying, "I dated Danica. She had just retired. She was depressed and not fun to be around. But I didn’t leave her because I was trying to be there and be a good partner. Then it was going a certain direction, obviously. There was no intimacy; there was nothing." "She tells a story that she was so blindsided … and that ‘he leaves a trail of blood around him.’ And I’m like, what are you talking about? That is not what happened, by any means." PUT YOUR ENTERTAINMENT KNOWLEDGE TO THE TEST AND SEE HOW YOU SCORE Shailene Woodley If Rodgers’ previous romances generated headlines, his whirlwind relationship with Shailene Woodley took things to another level. Speculation the two were romantically linked first surfaced in 2020, but by February 2021, Rodgers stunned fans by revealing he was engaged while accepting his third NFL MVP award. Woodley soon confirmed she was the mystery fiancée. But the fairy-tale ending never arrived. Their engagement unraveled, and the pair ultimately separated in 2022 after attempts at reconciliation. The breakup has remained a subject of public discussion: Woodley has spoken about experiencing a deeply difficult period around that time, while Rodgers offered his own sharply different account of their relationship and split in September 2026. On Heyward's podcast, Rodgers explained that he didn't "ruin" the actress's life during their 2022 split. "I proposed to Shailene and she said yes. Now, she maybe felt like she was forced to make a decision. She could have said no," Rodgers began. "A couple days after that, she tells me, 'Before we get married, I gotta go f--- this guy,' and I’m like – because her story is that I ruined her life and gave her crazy depression because I left her. But in actuality, she told me that, and then she took off the ring by March – I proposed in December – and we had a couple of times where we tried to get reunited and nothing ever happened," he said. "There wasn’t even a relationship in 2022 to break off. She literally told me, 'I don’t want to be with you' after we tried some reconciliation in 2021. There’s just a lot of narrative out there that isn’t true," Rodgers clarified. Woodley has not responded to Rodgers' claims. WATCH: SHAILENE WOODLEY LAUGHS OFF QUESTION ABOUT EX AARON RODGERS CLICK HERE TO DOWNLOAD THE FOX NEWS APP Brittani After years of very public romances, Rodgers ultimately married someone who has made a point of staying almost completely out of the spotlight. Rodgers revealed in June 2025 that he was a married man and later identified his wife only as Brittani. "In 2017, I met my wife, and at the time, she was leaving the States and going back to Europe," he told Heyward on the September podcast. "And my biggest regret is not begging her to stay or proposing right there, because that sent me right there into a tailspin of what can I be accused of as a partner in a relationship." The NFL star explained he met Brittani while she was living in Austin after attending The University of Texas. After the two didn't work out, she moved back to Europe before they reconnected years later. "She was engaged, then I got engaged, and luckily, for me, we came back together," he said. The couple quietly eloped in 2025, with Rodgers deliberately keeping his new wife away from the celebrity circus that surrounded his previous relationships. And the notoriously private quarterback is already looking toward their next chapter: Rodgers said in September 2026 that he hopes fatherhood is in his future after football.
